nusmp.page.book_creation.created_crystal: You create a shell of crystal from your own mana: Resistance and a few absorption hearts for ten seconds.
nusmp.page.book_creation.wind_hawk: Two hawks made of wind streams are created and hunt the nearest foes, striking from the air. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_creation.climbing_coelac: A coelacanth made of mana swims up through the air in a line, hitting what it passes and lifting it off the ground. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_creation.created_spear: A long spear of mana is thrust forward and pierces everything on its line. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_creation.created_shield: A created shield orbits you for ten seconds: your melee hits deal more and whoever strikes you is struck back.
nusmp.page.book_creation.created_arrows: Four created arrows leave your hand and curve toward the nearest foes. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_creation.created_chains: Chains made of mana wrap one foe: it is held in place and weakened (the shared control lock applies). Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_creation.created_hammer: A giant hammer is created at the aim point and slams down, knocking everything near it back. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_creation.created_steed: You create a steed of mana and ride it forward in one rush (a pure move, no damage).
nusmp.page.book_creation.created_cage: Bars of mana close in a cage at the aim point: foes inside take a little damage and are slowed hard for four seconds. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_creation.created_repairs: A workshop of mana mends you and your allies nearby for a fifth of their health.
nusmp.page.book_creation.created_colossu: A colossus of mana rises around you and crashes down: a heavy blast that knocks foes back and leaves them slowed. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mist.mist_doubles: Mist takes your shape while you slip away: mobs hunting you lose your trail and you turn invisible for three seconds.
nusmp.page.book_mist.mist_bullets: Mist is condensed into four water bullets that home in on the nearest foes. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mist.concealing_fog: A thick fog follows you for five seconds: foes inside cannot see you and are blinded, taking light damage. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mist.dew_needles: Three needles of condensed dew fly in a narrow fan. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mist.rolling_fog: A wave of cold fog rolls out in front of you, damaging and slowing foes in the cone. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mist.chilling_haze: A haze closes round you: nearby foes are chilled, slowed and weakened. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mist.vapor_lance: Steam is drawn into a lance and fired in a straight line through every foe on it. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mist.morning_mist: A soft morning mist settles on you and your allies nearby and restores a part of their health.
nusmp.page.book_mist.mist_ambush: You dissolve into mist and re-form behind your target, striking everything on the way. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mist.mist_cloak: A cloak of mist hides you for three seconds and quickens your steps for five.
nusmp.page.book_mist.sea_of_fog: The whole area is drowned in a sea of fog for five seconds: foes inside are blinded, slowed and wounded again and again. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_painting.heat_infused_ic: A circle opens and pours ice over one foe: it is held in place and left brittle (weakened). Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_painting.color_splash: A bucket of paint bursts at the aim point: foes in it are hit and blinded for a moment. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_painting.ink_darts: Three darts of wet ink fly from the brush and slow what they hit. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_painting.canvas_screen: You paint a screen before yourself: Resistance and an absorption heart for six seconds.
nusmp.page.book_painting.gloss_slide: You paint a glossy track under your feet and slide along it (a pure move, no damage).
nusmp.page.book_painting.wet_paint: A patch of wet paint is brushed on the ground: foes standing in it are slowed and take a little damage. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_painting.vague_azur: A wave of azure paint is swept across the field, hitting everything in a wide line and pushing it back. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_painting.etincelle_rouge: A streak of red paint becomes a spark that bursts on impact and sets foes alight. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_painting.verdure_embrace: You paint a green meadow beneath your allies: it restores a fifth of their health.
nusmp.page.book_painting.pigment_storm: A storm of flying pigments rages at the aim point for four seconds, wounding and blinding foes. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_painting.gallery_of_gian: Giants painted on the wall step out of the canvas and stamp down: a heavy blast that knocks foes back and slows them. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_snow.miniature_snow_gard: A tiny garden of drifting snow grows at the aim point: foes inside grow drowsy, slowed and clumsy for a few seconds. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_snow.snow_barrier: A barrier of whirling snow hides the area round you: foes inside cannot see and take a little cold damage. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_snow.snow_binding: Snow piles up and shapes itself round one foe, holding it still (the shared control lock applies). Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_snow.snow_powder_burst: A burst of powder snow explodes round you and pushes nearby foes away. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_snow.snowball_barrage: Four hard-packed snowballs are thrown in a fan and slow what they hit. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_snow.frostbite_wind: A freezing wind full of snow sweeps a cone before you: foes are cut, slowed and weakened. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_snow.snow_avalanche: A wall of snow is brought down on the aim point: a heavy blast that buries foes, pushes them back and slows them. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_ice.ice_funeral: Ice closes round you in a crown of spikes: a signature blast on every foe nearby. The ice also holds you, slowing you for three seconds (the canon spell kills the user too; here it only costs you your footing). Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_ice.ice_slicer: A sharp icicle rises from the ground and flies at your target, slicing and freezing it in place. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_ice.ice_needle: Two thin needles of ice fly at the foes in front of you. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_ice.jotunns_ice_floe: A ball of ice forms in the air above the aim point and is smashed down half a second later, hitting and slowing everything under it. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_ice.cage_of_infinite_hai: Hail falls without end inside a cage of ice and mist at the aim point: foes in it are pelted and slowed for five seconds. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_ice.endless_ice_fangs: A row of ice fangs bursts out of the ground in a wide line, hitting and throwing foes into the air. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_water.sea_dragon_god_vor: A whirlpool opens at the aim point and drags every foe in it toward its centre, hitting and slowing them. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_water.sea_dragon_god_tai: A tail of water sweeps round in a wide arc and throws back everything it hits. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_water.riptide_undertow: A current seizes one foe by the legs and holds it in place (the shared control lock applies). Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_water.riptide_dash: You ride a wave forward, hitting and pushing aside everything on the way. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_water.tidal_geyser: A geyser bursts up under the aim point and throws the foes above it into the air. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.brine_lash: A whip of black brine cracks along a line and slows what it hits. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.drowned_chai: Chains of black water hold one foe in place and sap its strength (the shared control lock applies). Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.abyssal_ambu: You sink into the dark water and rise behind your target, striking everything on the way. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.black_deluge: A deluge of black water floods the aim point for five seconds: foes in it are battered and slowed. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_demon_water.depth_pressu: The pressure of the deep crushes round you: nearby foes are hurt, pushed away and left dizzy. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mucus.mucus_spit: You spit a spray of sticky mucus in a cone: foes are hit and slowed. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mucus.mucus_siphon: A blob of mucus flies at one foe, soaks up a little of its magicule and feeds a part of it to you as health. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mucus.mucus_cocoon: You wrap yourself in a cocoon of mucus: Resistance II and absorption hearts for eight seconds.
nusmp.page.book_mucus.glob_slam: A huge glob of mucus is dropped on the aim point: foes under it are hit, pushed and slowed. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mucus.mucus_whirl: Mucus swirls into a whirlpool at the aim point and drags foes toward its centre, slowing them. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mud.mud_splash: Mud splashes up round you and into the eyes of the foes nearby. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mud.mud_slide: You slide forward on a rush of mud, bumping aside what is in the way. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mud.grasping_mud: A hand of mud grabs one foe and drags it to you. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_mud.mud_armor: A hard crust of mud covers you for twelve seconds: your melee hits deal more, you take less, and attackers are struck back.
nusmp.page.book_mud.quagmire: The ground at the aim point turns into a quagmire for five seconds: foes sink in it, are hurt and are slowed hard. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_food.mana_munch: You bite the mana out of one foe: a little damage, a part of its magicule is taken, and you recover some health. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_food.restoring_plate: A plate of warm food restores a part of the health of you and your allies nearby.
nusmp.page.book_food.spice_burst: A cloud of burning spice explodes round you and sets nearby foes alight. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_food.syrup_flood: A flood of sticky syrup spreads at the aim point for four seconds: foes in it are slowed and hurt. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_eye.hypnotic_gaze: Your eyes catch one foe: it is held where it stands, dazed and hurt (the shared control lock applies). Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_eye.dazzle_sweep: You sweep your gaze across a wide cone: foes in it are dazzled and blinded for two seconds. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_eye.silencing_gaze: A narrow gaze lands on the foes in front of you and shuts their magic for three seconds. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_eye.watchful_circle: Eyes open round you for four seconds: foes in the circle are hurt, weakened and made visible through walls. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_fang: Three fangs of black ice fly from your hand and slow what they bite. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_chai: Chains of black ice freeze one foe solid for a moment (the shared control lock applies). Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_demon_ice.demon_ice_come: A comet of black ice is called down on the aim point and lands a second later, hurting and badly slowing everything under it. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_bubble.soap_slide: You slide forward on a track of soap bubbles (a pure move, no damage).
nusmp.page.book_bubble.bubble_whirl: Bubbles whirl at the aim point and draw the foes into a lifting current. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_bubble.bubble_bath: A warm bath of bubbles rises under you and your allies nearby and restores a fifth of their health.
nusmp.page.book_ice_wedge.wedge_anchor: A wedge of ice is driven in beside one foe and anchors it to the spot (the shared control lock applies). Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_ice_wedge.wedge_spiral: A spiral of wedges drills forward in a line, hitting everything on it and slowing it. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_ice_wedge.wedge_cataclys: Giant wedges are called down on the aim point and land three quarters of a second later, hurting and pushing back everything under them. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_gel.gel_whip: A whip of gel wraps one foe and drags it toward you. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_gel.gel_mortar: A lump of gel is lobbed and bursts on impact, splattering and slowing foes round the point. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_gel.gel_flood: A flood of gel covers the aim point for five seconds: foes in it are hurt and held down. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_black_oil.oil_spray: A spray of black oil washes over the foes in front of you and blights them for two seconds. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_black_oil.tar_chains: Chains of thick tar hold one foe in place while it is blighted (the shared control lock applies). Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_black_oil.oil_geyser: Oil seeps into the ground at the aim point and erupts in a geyser a second later, hurting, lifting and blighting foes above it. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.eyeball_volley: Three eyeballs are shot from your hand and home in on the nearest foes. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.optic_beam: Your eyeballs line up and fire one beam along a line, hurting and blinding everything on it. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.eyeball_storm: A storm of eyeballs circles you for five seconds: foes near you are hurt, weakened and made visible through walls. Its damage scales with your EP and the book's mastery.
